info.title: livingin.jp API
info.description:
Backend contract for livingin.jp. This document is generated from the backend's zod schemas
(`npm run contract:generate`); do not edit it by hand.

Conventions (identifiers, time, money, unknown values, pagination, errors, idempotency, concurrency,
authentication and the mock server's `Prefer: example=<scenario>` header) are specified in
docs/api/CONVENTIONS.md. Fixtures for every operation live in backend/fixtures/.

Every response carries `X-Request-Id`. Every error is `application/problem+json` (RFC 9457) with a stable
`code`. When the backend runs in `live` mode, operations whose implementation has not shipped yet return
501 `not_implemented`; use the mock server for those.

Feature gate: `living.my_life`.

get.description:
Listed groups only: unlisted groups never appear, even to their members. Results are identical for every viewer and never include member names, so search cannot reveal anyone’s membership; sensitive groups appear with a hidden member count. livingin.jp does not suggest or assign groups from inferred traits. Sorted by relevance when `q` is given, otherwise by name; cursors are stable.

Feature gate: `community.groups`. Anonymous access allowed; the response may include viewer-specific fields when signed in.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Matches group name, tagline and description only, never member names or posts.

parameters.name: locality
parameters.description: Prefecture or municipality code. Returns only `local` groups (including chapters) in that jurisdiction. Omit to browse national, online and local groups without choosing a location.

get.description:
An unlisted group returns 404 to anyone without an active or pending membership, indistinguishable from a group that does not exist. Sensitive groups never expose members, member count or (to non-members) admins, and clients must not show their names in default notification previews.

Feature gate: `community.groups`. Anonymous access allowed; the response may include viewer-specific fields when signed in.

200.description: A group, with the viewer’s membership state when signed in.

get.description:
Active members only: admins and moderators first, then by `joined_at` (stable cursor). Access follows `membership_visibility`; anyone else receives 403 `forbidden` (members of sensitive groups are never public). An unlisted group returns 404 to non-members. Members who blocked the viewer, or whom the viewer blocked, are omitted.

Feature gate: `community.groups`. Anonymous access allowed; the response may include viewer-specific fields when signed in.

post.summary: Join or request to join a group
post.description:
Open groups: 201 with an `active` membership. Approval groups: 202 with a `pending` membership for an admin to review. If the viewer already has an active or pending membership it is returned unchanged; a second membership is never created. 403 `forbidden` for invite-only groups and for viewers removed or blocked from the group. An unlisted group returns 404 to non-members. For sensitive groups, notifications about the request never name the group in their default preview.

Feature gate: `community.groups`. Idempotent with `Idempotency-Key`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated unique key (UUID recommended). Retries with the same key and body replay the original response.

202.description: Join request recorded for an approval group; not yet a member.

get.description:
Published posts only, pinned first, then newest first (stable cursor). Access follows `post_visibility`: members-only content returns 403 `forbidden` to anonymous viewers and non-members; an unlisted group returns 404 to non-members. Posts by members the viewer has blocked, or who blocked the viewer, are omitted. Posts are residents’ contributions and are never verified by livingin.jp; see `experience_label`. Request posts appear only while `community.requests` is enabled.

Feature gate: `community.conversation`. Anonymous access allowed; the response may include viewer-specific fields when signed in.

parameters.name: pinned
parameters.description: `true`: pinned posts only. `false`: unpinned posts only.

post.description:
Active members only; anyone else receives 403 `forbidden` (an unlisted group returns 404 to non-members). Returns the author’s view with `publication`: `published`, `pending_review` (the group reviews posts first, or screening has not finished) or `held` (a moderator must decide). A `request` post also requires the `community.requests` feature (403 `feature_disabled` otherwise). Notifications about posts in sensitive groups never name the group or quote the post in default previews.

Feature gate: `community.conversation`. Idempotent with `Idempotency-Key`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated unique key (UUID recommended). Retries with the same key and body replay the original response.

get.description:
Returns occurrences (not series) overlapping the date range, including cancelled, postponed and rescheduled ones marked by `status` so people who saw them can tell they changed. Group-only events appear only for members of the hosting group. Expected (projected) occurrences are included and labelled. New or changed events can take up to a minute to appear here; `getEvent` is authoritative.

Feature gate: `events.events`. Anonymous access allowed; the response may include viewer-specific fields when signed in.

parameters.name: locality
parameters.description: Prefecture or municipality whose venues to include (jurisdiction of the venue, not proximity). Online-only events have no locality and are excluded when this is set.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First date to include, in Asia/Tokyo. Defaults to today.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last date to include (inclusive), in Asia/Tokyo. Must not be before `from`; at most 366 days after it.

A recurring activity with its rule, exceptions and upcoming occurrences. Group-only series return 404 to non-members.

Cancelled and rescheduled occurrences stay readable. Group-only events, and events by members the viewer has blocked, return 404. Responses for signed-in viewers carry `viewer` (and, for confirmed participants, online join details) and are private, never publicly cached. Cancellations reach participants through the urgent notification lane, not moderation batches.

Feature gate: `events.events`. Anonymous access allowed; the response may include viewer-specific fields when signed in.

post.description:
Capacity is allocated atomically, so concurrent requests cannot overbook the last place. A full event returns 201 with `state: waitlisted` — not an error. Approval-based events return `pending_approval`. If the viewer already has a going, pending or waitlisted RSVP it is returned unchanged with 200; if they hold an unexpired offer, this accepts it (200, `going`). 409 `conflict` when the occurrence uses external registration (register with the organizer; saving is not registering), is cancelled, postponed or rescheduled, is only `expected`, has started, or the organizer declined this member’s earlier request.

Feature gate: `events.participation`. Idempotent with `Idempotency-Key`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

200.description: Existing RSVP returned, or a waitlist offer accepted.

delete.description:
Cancels a going, pending, waitlisted or offered RSVP. A released place is offered atomically to the first waitlisted member. Naturally idempotent: repeating the request returns the same cancelled RSVP. Returns 404 unless the RSVP is the viewer’s own.

Feature gate: `events.participation`.

The signed-in member’s RSVPs, each with its occurrence. Saved (bookmarked) events are not RSVPs and are not listed here.

get.summary: Current official warnings for an area
get.description:
Official warnings for a prefecture or municipality with feed freshness, source health and coverage. Held: this feature stays disabled until source, semantics, replay and outage evidence exist (#41, #42). Warnings are ingested on a dedicated urgent lane, separate from marketplace moderation and publication batches, and never wait for them. Responses are short-lived: do not cache beyond `feed.freshness.stale_after`. An empty `warnings` array is only "no warnings in effect" when the feed is `available` and `current`. Stale, unavailable and not-covered states must never be presented as safety. livingin.jp is a supplementary information service, not an official warning or emergency alert service. It may be delayed, incomplete or unavailable; always follow the issuer and your municipality. Unknown locality codes return 404.

Feature gate: `safety.live_warnings`.

parameters.name: locality_code
parameters.description: Prefecture (`JP-13`) or municipality (`JP-13-112`) code. A prefecture returns warnings affecting any part of it.

200.description: Area status. Check `coverage` and `feed.status` before reading `warnings`.

get.summary: Reviewed preparedness and official safety resources
get.description:
Hazard maps, evacuation information pages, official alert services, preparedness guides, emergency contacts and multilingual support. Without `locality`, national resources are returned. Links lead to the publisher, which stays authoritative.

Feature gate: `safety.preparedness`.

parameters.name: locality
parameters.description: `JP`, a prefecture or a municipality code. Returns resources for that jurisdiction and its parents.

200.description: A page of resources with coverage for the requested locality.

get.description: Feature gate: `safety.preparedness`.

followed_localities.description: Optional. Members can browse without choosing any location.

Account.description: Private account record. Only ever returned to its owner.

ActivationState.description: `held`: implemented or contracted, but waiting on a human, legal, source or operating decision before activation.

summary.description: The entry’s other descriptive strings are in `summary.lang` and share its translation state.

entry_visa.description: The related entry visa, if any. A separate concept from the status.

AlmanacEntry.description: Reference record for one status of residence. Visa, status of residence, period of stay and procedure are separate fields and never collapsed into one. Only reviewed entries are published. Reference information, not legal advice or a prediction of any decision.

AlmanacEntryVisa.description: An entry visa (査証): issued abroad before travel to support an application for landing. Not the status of residence, and does not by itself permit residence or work.

AlmanacPeriodOfStay.description: A period of stay (在留期間) that may be granted with the status. The authority decides the period in each decision; the applicant does not choose it.

use_when.description: When this procedure is the relevant one.

fee.description: `unknown`: livingin.jp does not currently hold a verified fee. Never shown as zero. `not_applicable`: the procedure has no fee in this version.

fee_note.description: How or when the fee is paid, or why it is unknown.

processing_time.description: `unknown`: no evidence held. Evidence is never a promised turnaround.

AlmanacProcedure.description: An application procedure (手続き) for a status. Fees, requirements and processing evidence belong to a procedure version, not to the status or the visa.

AlmanacProcedureVersion.description: The version of the procedure that the fee, requirements and evidence belong to.

scope.description: What the statistic covers, e.g. which applications and where.

AlmanacProcessingEvidence.description: Evidence about stated or past processing times. Guidance, official statistics and community reports are different kinds of evidence and are never merged. None of them is a promise or an estimate for a particular application.

AlmanacRequirement.description: A requirement of one procedure version, with the sources it comes from. Listing a requirement is not a statement that meeting it is sufficient.

permitted_activities.description: Summary of the activities the status covers. Reference information, not a determination for any person.

AlmanacStatusOfResidence.description: A status of residence (在留資格): the category of activities a person may engage in while residing in Japan. Not a visa, a period of stay or a procedure.

label.description: Coarse, human-readable area such as a neighbourhood or station. Never an exact address.

coverage.description: `partial` lists what is not carried (for example warning types handled only by official alert services). `unsupported` comes with `feed.status = not_covered`.

official_fallbacks.description: Official places to check the authoritative current situation. Always present; most important when the feed is stale, unavailable or not covered.

disclaimer.description: Notice that livingin.jp is supplementary to official sources and makes no delivery promise. Show it with the status.

AreaSafetyStatus.description: Current official warnings for an area, with feed health and coverage. Contains no inferred safe routes, no shelter-open status and no delivery promise; livingin.jp is supplementary to official sources.

AssertionBasis.description: `reported`: stated by the submitter (employer, seller, organizer) and not checked. `verified`: checked by livingin.jp against evidence. `source_derived`: taken from a cited source record.

body.description: Plain text. Clients must not render it as HTML.

pinned.description: Pinned by a group admin, e.g. a resource list.

body.description: Plain text. Clients must not render it as HTML.

pinned.description: Pinned by a group admin, e.g. a resource list.

AuthorGroupPost.description: The author’s private view of their post, including publication state.

CalendarDate.description: A calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) with no time of day. Interpreted in the accompanying time zone, or Asia/Tokyo when none is given.

Coverage.description: `unsupported` means livingin.jp does not maintain this jurisdiction, procedure or scenario. It is different from a supported query that matched nothing (an empty list).

ErrorCode.description: Stable machine-readable error code. See docs/api/CONVENTIONS.md#errors.

visibility.description: `group_members`: visible only to members of the hosting group; everyone else receives 404.

requirements.description: `null` when the organizer stated no requirements.

languages.description: Languages the organizer says will be used.

accessibility.description: Organizer- or source-stated accessibility information. Not verified by livingin.jp unless `basis` says so.

Event.description: One occurrence: a specific date and place. Part of a series when it recurs.

offered_count.description: Places held for waitlisted members who have an unexpired offer.

stated_limit.description: Capacity stated by the organizer or source, if any. livingin.jp does not know how many places remain.

EventCapacity.description: Places are allocated atomically: `going_count + offered_count` never exceeds `limit`, and once they reach it new RSVPs join the waitlist. `not_tracked`: attendance is handled outside livingin.jp.

EventConfirmation.description: `confirmed`: the organizer or source announced this specific occurrence. `expected`: projected from a recurring announcement (the series rule). An expected occurrence is not proof that it will happen, and RSVPs open only once it is confirmed. Read together with `status`: a cancelled occurrence can be confirmed (the cancellation was announced).

EventCost.description: Participation cost. Paid to the organizer; livingin.jp handles no payments. Wrapped in a Knowable so unknown is never shown as free.

EventFormat.description: Always matches `location.kind` on the full event.

meeting_point.description: `null` when participants meet at the venue.
`null` when participants meet at the venue.

EventLocation.description: Venue and meeting point are distinct. Online-only events have no locality.

EventMeetingPoint.description: Where participants gather, when that differs from the venue (e.g. a hike meets at a station but the venue is a trail). The event starts here at the start time.

platform.description: Organizer-stated platform or method, e.g. a video-call service.

join.description: `available`: shown only to viewers whose RSVP is `going` (responses containing it are private and never publicly cached). `participants_only`: the viewer is not a confirmed participant. `via_external_registration`: the organizer sends access details after registering on their site.

name.description: Organizer name as published by the source. Not a livingin.jp organization record and not verified.

EventOrganizer.description: Who runs the event. Separate from provenance: an imported record can name an organization, and the calendar it came from is not necessarily the organizer.

basis.description: Everything here is stated by the organizer.

safety_certification.description: livingin.jp does not assess or certify routes, difficulty, fitness, gear or safety. More values may be added only if such a review is introduced.

EventOrganizerRequirements.description: Organizer-provided expectations, e.g. for outdoor activities. Not a platform safety certification.

registration_tracking.description: livingin.jp never knows whether the viewer registered externally. Saving the event is a bookmark, not a registration or reservation.

notice.description: Safe, human-readable explanation that saving the event is not registering.

EventParticipation.description: `rsvp_open`: joining is immediate while places remain, then the waitlist. `rsvp_approval`: the organizer approves each request. `external_registration`: register with the organizer, not on livingin.jp. `no_registration_needed`: just turn up.

created_by.description: Which kind of organizer created the record on livingin.jp.

source_record_key.description: The source’s own identifier for this record, kept for deduplication and change tracking.

freshness.description: `checked_at` is when livingin.jp last checked the source. `stale` means the source could not be confirmed recently; dates and cancellations may be out of date.

EventProvenance.description: Where the record came from. Imported records keep their source and are re-checked; conflicting facts from different sources go to review rather than silently overwriting each other.

rrule.description: RFC 5545 RRULE value (without the `RRULE:` prefix), evaluated in `time_zone` from `starts_on`.

summary.description: Human-readable rule in the negotiated language.

EventRecurrence.description: `rule`: a regular pattern. `irregular`: dates are announced individually and nothing is projected. A rule only produces `expected` occurrences; it never manufactures confirmed ones.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page. `null` on the last page.

EventSearchResult.description: Occurrences, soonest first (ties broken by id, so pages are stable). Member, group and organization events are available everywhere, but imported municipal calendars cover pilot localities only, so `coverage` is `partial` (with limitations) unless the requested locality is a pilot.

location.description: Usual location. An individual occurrence may differ; the occurrence is authoritative.

exceptions.description: Cancelled and moved dates, soonest first. Includes recent past exceptions.

upcoming_occurrences.description: Next occurrences (up to 12), including cancelled and rescheduled ones so changes stay visible. Each says whether it is `confirmed` or only `expected`.

EventSeries.description: A recurring activity. The series describes the pattern; each occurrence is a separate Event.

reason.description: Reason given by the organizer (`reported`) or source (`source_derived`); `unknown` when none was given.
Reason given by the organizer (`reported`) or source (`source_derived`); `unknown` when none was given.

EventSeriesException.description: A departure from the recurrence rule for one date. Dates are in the series time zone.

reason.description: Reason given by the organizer (`reported`) or source (`source_derived`); `unknown` when none was given.

EventSeriesStatus.description: Status of the whole series, distinct from any single occurrence. Cancelling the series cancels every future occurrence.

start_time.description: Wall-clock time (HH:MM) in the accompanying time zone.

end_time.description: Wall-clock time (HH:MM) in the accompanying time zone.

EventSourceKind.description: Where the record comes from. `member`, `group`, `organization`: created on livingin.jp by that kind of organizer. `imported`: normalized from an external calendar (e.g. a pilot municipality, #44), whatever the organizer is.

reason.description: Reason given by the organizer (`reported`) or source (`source_derived`); `unknown` when none was given.

moved_to_event_id.description: The replacement occurrence. RSVPs do not transfer automatically; participants are notified and RSVP to the new occurrence.

reason.description: Reason given by the organizer (`reported`) or source (`source_derived`); `unknown` when none was given.
Reason given by the organizer (`reported`) or source (`source_derived`); `unknown` when none was given.

EventStatus.description: Lifecycle of one occurrence. `postponed`: called off for now with no new date yet; it becomes `rescheduled` once a new occurrence is announced. Cancelled and rescheduled occurrences remain readable. Cancellations and reschedules are sent to everyone with an active RSVP and everyone who saved the event through the urgent notification lane — never held in moderation or marketplace batches. Only the organizer (or, for imported events, the source) can cancel; weather alone never cancels an event automatically.

ends_at.description: `unknown` when the organizer or source gave only a start time. Never invented.

end_date.description: Inclusive. Equal to `start_date` for a one-day event.

EventTiming.description: Instants are UTC; `time_zone` (normally Asia/Tokyo) is the zone the organizer scheduled in. All-day dates are calendar dates, never midnight instants.

address.description: Street address of a public venue (hall, park, café). `not_applicable` for places without one, such as a trail. Member-hosted events never publish a private home address.

EventVenue.description: Where the activity itself takes place.

rsvp_state.description: The viewer’s RSVP to this occurrence. Always `none` for external-registration events, even when saved.

offer_expires_at.description: Set only when `offered`: the place is released to the next person after this.

saved.description: Bookmarked. Not an RSVP, and for imported events not a confirmed external registration.

EventViewer.description: The signed-in viewer’s relationship to this occurrence. Responses that include it are private.

reason.description: Why the feature is disabled or held, when it is.

coverage_note.description: Enabled scope limits, e.g. pilot localities only.

Freshness.description: Whether data still satisfies its freshness requirement. Unavailable data is modelled separately and never presented as current.

languages.description: Languages the group converses in (BCP 47). Japanese speakers are welcome in every group.

sensitive.description: Set by the group’s admins or livingin.jp operators because of the group’s topic, never inferred from members. Sensitive groups never expose their members, member count, admins (to non-members) or posts publicly, and their names must not appear in default notification previews, email subjects or other surfaces visible outside the signed-in app.

rules.description: Group rules written by the admins, in addition to the site-wide community guidelines. `null` when the group has none of its own.

parent.description: The group this is a chapter of. `null` for a top-level group.

chapters.description: Optional sub-groups, e.g. local chapters of a national group. Each chapter is a group with its own settings and memberships. Only chapters the viewer may discover are included; chapters of a sensitive group are sensitive.

Group.description: A group with its independent discoverability, membership-visibility, post-visibility and join settings.

GroupAdminList.description: The people who run the group. `hidden` in sensitive groups unless the viewer is an active member, because naming them would reveal their membership.

GroupDiscoverability.description: `listed`: appears in group discovery and search. `unlisted`: never listed or searchable, and returns 404 to anyone without an active or pending membership. Independent of membership visibility.

GroupJoinPolicy.description: `open`: joining is immediate. `approval`: an admin reviews each request. `invite_only`: people cannot join or request on their own.

GroupKind.description: What the group is about, chosen by its admins. People choose groups themselves; livingin.jp never infers a person’s language, background or circumstances, and never adds anyone to a group.

GroupMemberCount.description: Number of active members. `hidden` for sensitive groups and for groups whose membership visibility is `admins_only`. A hidden count is not zero. The value is the same for every viewer, so it never reveals the viewer’s own membership.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page. `null` on the last page.

GroupMembership.description: An active member as shown in a group’s member list. Pending, removed and blocked people never appear.

GroupMembershipVisibility.description: Who can see the member list. `public`: anyone (never allowed for sensitive groups). `members_only`: active members. `admins_only`: admins and moderators. Independent of discoverability.

body.description: Plain text. Clients must not render it as HTML.

pinned.description: Pinned by a group admin, e.g. a resource list.

body.description: Plain text. Clients must not render it as HTML.

pinned.description: Pinned by a group admin, e.g. a resource list.

GroupPost.description: A published post as group readers see it. Request posts carry a `request` block.

GroupPostExperienceBasis.description: `personal_experience`: the author describes their own situation; it may not apply to anyone else and is not official guidance. `shared_resource`: points to or summarises an external source; the source is authoritative, the summary is not reviewed. `conversation`: an introduction, question, request or chat with no factual claim.

verification.description: livingin.jp does not check group posts, even ones that link to official sources. More values may be added only if a reviewed process is introduced.

GroupPostExperienceLabel.description: Makes clear what kind of claim a post makes, so a resident’s personal experience is never mistaken for verified or official information. Chosen by the author; moderators may correct it.

request.description: Required when `kind` is `request`; not allowed otherwise.

GroupPostInput.description: Pinning is done by admins separately and cannot be set here.

GroupPostKind.description: `request`: a wanted item, recommendation or activity interest (#28), gated by the `community.requests` feature.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page. `null` on the last page.

reviewer.description: `group_moderators`: the group reviews posts (e.g. from new members) before they appear. `automated_screening`: screening has not finished.

GroupPostPublication.description: Whether other members can see the post yet. `pending_review` and `held` posts are visible only to the author and group moderators; no publication is implied.

GroupPostVisibility.description: Who can read the group’s posts. Sensitive groups are always `members_only`, because a post reveals its author’s membership.

GroupRef.description: Minimal reference to a group, e.g. the national group a chapter belongs to.

note.description: Optional note from the author on how the request was resolved.

resolution.description: Set by the request’s author (or a group moderator). Resolution is self-reported.

linked_event_id.description: The event created from this request, if any. Creating an event never RSVPs, invites or names the people who replied or expressed interest: each participant explicitly chooses to RSVP to the event themselves.

GroupRequest.description: The request block of a `request` post (#28).

GroupRequestType.description: `activity_interest`: the author is gauging interest or availability for an activity, which may later become an event.

GroupScope.description: `national`: for people anywhere in Japan. `online`: meets online only. `local`: centred on one prefecture or municipality; this describes where the group meets, not where its members live. Location is never required to browse or join.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page. `null` on the last page.

GroupSearchResult.description: Listed groups only. Identical for every viewer.

tagline.description: One-line description written by the admins.

languages.description: Languages the group converses in (BCP 47), chosen by its admins. Not a statement about members’ nationality or background.

parent.description: The group this is a chapter of. `null` for a top-level group.

GroupSummary.description: A group as shown in discovery results and chapter lists. Contains no member names and no viewer-specific state.

can_join.description: `true` when joinGroup would add the viewer or create a pending request.

GroupViewerMembership.description: The signed-in viewer’s relationship to the group. `pending`: a join request awaits an admin. `removed`: an admin ended the viewer’s membership; they cannot rejoin on their own but may be invited back. `blocked`: the viewer may not join, be invited or post until an admin lifts the block.

revision.description: Published content revision. Drafts and unpublished revisions are never served. Tasks created from the guide record the revision they came from.

body.description: Article-style explanation. CommonMark without raw HTML.

sources_checked_at.description: Last automated check of the cited sources for changes. An automated check never counts as human review.

Guide.description: A maintained guide or procedure. Official, editorial and provider information are distinguished by `sources[].authority`.

GuideAnchorEvent.description: The event a deadline counts from, e.g. `moved_in`: “the day you moved into your new address”.

example.description: The day you moved into your new address

conditions.description: The guide applies to a reader when every `applies_if` condition holds and no `excluded_if` condition does. Empty: everyone within the scope.

GuideApplicability.description: Where (jurisdiction or provider) and to whom a guide applies.

code.description: Stable machine-readable key. The same code means the same condition everywhere in a guide or entry, so a reader answers it once.

description.example: Family members live with you in Japan

GuideAudienceCondition.description: A condition on who the guide is for.

key.description: Referenced by `GuideStepDocument.document_key` within the same guide.

aliases.description: Other names for the same document that readers may see on forms or hear at a counter.

description.description: What the document is and where it comes from.

GuideDocument.description: A document a reader may need to bring or obtain.

GuideDueRule.description: A reviewed rule for deriving a deadline. The server applies it; clients never compute rule-derived deadlines themselves.

GuideFormat.description: `procedure`: ordered, possibly conditional steps. `explainer`: article-style explanation with no checklist.

GuideLifecycle.description: `withdrawn`: no longer maintained or no longer applicable. The guide still resolves so saved links and tasks can explain what happened, but it is excluded from `listGuides` and its content must not be presented as current.

step_key.description: The step this action belongs to. `null`: the whole guide.

rule_version.description: Version of the suggestion and its due rule. Recorded on any task created from it.

step_key.description: The step this action belongs to. `null`: the whole guide.
The step this action belongs to. `null`: the whole guide.
The step this action belongs to. `null`: the whole guide.
The step this action belongs to. `null`: the whole guide.

GuideRelatedAction.description: A typed reference to something the reader can do next; presentation is up to the client. `suggest_task` becomes a private task only when the member calls `createMyTask` with origin `rule_derived`; nothing is created automatically.

GuideScope.description: Whose rules or process the guide describes. `national`: the same everywhere in Japan. `prefecture`/`municipality`: that jurisdiction’s procedure only; it never applies to a neighbouring area, however close. `provider`: one organization’s own process (for example a bank) within its `service_area` (`JP` for nationwide).

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page. `null` on the last page.

coverage.description: Coverage of *local* (prefecture and municipality) guides for the requested `locality`. National and nationwide provider guides apply everywhere and are still returned when local coverage is `partial` or `unsupported`; an unsupported locality is never presented as having no local procedures. `supported` when no `locality` is given.

GuideSearchResult.description: The `locality` filter matches by jurisdiction, not proximity: national guides, guides for the containing prefecture, guides for that exact municipality, and provider guides whose service area contains it. Guides for neighbouring municipalities are never returned as matches.

key.description: Stable within the guide across revisions while the step keeps its meaning.

instructions.description: CommonMark without raw HTML. Translation state is per field, so one step can be stale while others are current.

source_ids.description: Entries in the guide’s `sources` that support this step.

GuideStepDocument.description: A document needed for one step, possibly only under a condition.

variant_of.description: The national (or wider) guide this local guide specializes. `null` if it is not a variant.

GuideTopic.description: Life area. More topics may be added; clients must tolerate unknown values.

state.description: `completed` is reported by the participants; livingin.jp does not handle payment or verify handover.

Inquiry.description: Private coordination between a buyer and seller about specific items.

Instant.description: An instant in time: RFC 3339, UTC, `Z` suffix.

ItemAvailability.description: Inventory state, set by the seller. Independent of publication/review state; changing it never requires re-review.

language_expectations.description: Employer-reported working-language expectations. When `known`, the list always contains a `ja` entry (which may be `required_level: none`).

application_id.description: The viewer’s own private tracking record for this job, if any. Never visible to the employer or agency.

viewer.description: `null` for anonymous viewers. Responses with a non-null `viewer` are private and must not be cached publicly.

Job.description: A job record with transparent, separately knowable conditions. Conditions are stated by the employer or agency (directly or through an authorized feed) and are not verified by livingin.jp. No job-quality verdict, score or endorsement is expressed.

name.description: e.g. 夜勤手当 / やきんてあて / night-shift allowance.

condition.description: Eligibility condition as stated. `null`: no condition stated.

job_id.description: The livingin.jp job being tracked. `null` for a job found elsewhere.

stage.description: Equals the stage of the last `stage_history` entry.

notes.description: Private notes. Empty string when none.

JobApplication.description: A member’s private tracking record for one job. Only ever returned to its owner; never shared with employers, agencies or other members, and never part of a public profile.

job_id.description: Track a livingin.jp job. Closed and withdrawn jobs can still be tracked.

title.description: Required without `job_id`. Defaults to the job’s title.

employer_name.description: Required without `job_id`. Defaults to the employer or agency name shown on the job.

JobApplicationCreateInput.description: The initial stage is recorded as set by the member.

employer_name.description: As the member entered or saw it, e.g. "Undisclosed client (via Example Career Partners)". Not verified and not linked to an organization record.

url.description: Where the member found the job, if recorded. Never fetched or checked by livingin.jp.

JobApplicationJobSnapshot.description: Kept as captured, so later edits, closure or withdrawal of a listing do not rewrite the member’s record.

due_on.description: Asia/Tokyo calendar date. `null`: no due date set.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page. `null` on the last page.

JobApplicationPatchInput.description: Fields to replace. Changing `stage` appends a `stage_history` entry set by the member; any stage may be chosen. `job_id` cannot change.

JobApplicationStage.description: Private tracking stage. `external_handoff_opened`: the member opened the external apply route; this is NOT a submitted application, and livingin.jp cannot see whether one was sent. `submitted`: the member says they applied outside livingin.jp; only ever set by the member. `declined`: the member turned down an offer. `rejected`: the member reports the employer said no. `withdrawn`: the member withdrew. `accepted`, `declined`, `rejected` and `withdrawn` are terminal for reminders, but the member may still change the stage to correct a mistake.

oneOf.description: Recorded when the signed-in member opened this job’s apply handoff from livingin.jp. The system only ever records `external_handoff_opened`, only from `saved` or `preparing`, and never records `submitted` or any later stage.

note.description: Display text stating that opening the link does not submit an application.

JobApplyRoute.description: Applications are made outside livingin.jp. Opening the handoff does not submit an application, and livingin.jp sends no applicant details to the employer or agency.

JobBasePay.description: Gross base pay before deductions. When `overtime.fixed_overtime.kind` is `included_in_base_pay`, this figure already includes that fixed overtime pay.

oneOf.description: The submitter states that no bonus is paid.

previous_year_months.description: Bonus paid last year in months of monthly base pay, as reported. A reference figure, not a promise.

JobCategory.description: Broad occupational grouping for browsing. Not a status-of-residence category and says nothing about who may lawfully take the job.

JobCommutingAllowance.description: 交通費 (kōtsūhi). `not_applicable` for fully remote work.

allowances.description: `known` with an empty list: the submitter states there are no allowances. `unknown`: not stated.

JobCompensation.description: Each component as reported by the submitter. livingin.jp does not compute a total or an estimate: an `unknown` component is never treated as zero.

conditions_differ.description: Whether pay or conditions during probation differ from those listed.

JobEmploymentType.description: `full_time`: 正社員 (seishain), a regular employee, normally without a fixed term. `contract`: 契約社員, a fixed-term contract, usually full-time hours. `part_time`: パート・アルバイト. `dispatch`: 派遣社員, employed by a dispatch agency and placed with a host company; used exactly when `hiring_arrangement.kind` is `dispatch`. As reported by the submitter.

employer.description: The organization you would sign an employment contract with.

oneOf.description: The employer posts its own vacancy.

agency.description: The agency (職業紹介) that introduces candidates. It is not the employer.

employer.description: The client company you would sign an employment contract with. `unknown` when the agency has not disclosed it in the listing.

oneOf.description: A placement agency introduces candidates; the employment contract is with the client employer.

agency.description: The dispatch agency (派遣元). It is the employer of record: the employment contract and pay come from the agency.

host_company.description: Where the work is performed and directed (派遣先). `unknown` when the agency has not disclosed it.

oneOf.description: Worker dispatch (派遣, haken): employed by the agency, working at a host company.

JobHiringArrangement.description: Direct, agency-introduced or dispatched employment, as reported by the submitter. Organization `verification` confirms who controls the record; it is not an endorsement, licence check or quality assessment.

oneOf.description: 社宅 or 寮: housing provided by the employer.
住宅手当. Listed here, not in `allowances`.

JobImmigrationAssistance.description: What the employer or agency says about help with residence procedures. When `known`, `basis` is always `reported`: livingin.jp has not checked it. livingin.jp does not guarantee visa sponsorship or any immigration outcome, and this field never means that a person is permitted to take this job; whether a status of residence allows particular work is decided by the immigration authorities.

oneOf.description: The employer reports that it does not offer help with residence procedures.

support.description: Kinds of help the employer says it offers with residence procedures.

lang.description: BCP 47 language tag of the working language, e.g. `ja`, `en`, `vi`.

preferred_level.description: A higher level the employer would welcome. `null`: none stated.

certificate.description: Certificate the employer asks for, e.g. "JLPT N2". `null`: no certificate requested.

JobLanguageLevel.description: Ordered from lowest to highest. `none`: not needed. `basic`: greetings and simple instructions. `conversational`: everyday workplace conversation. `business`: meetings, phone calls and written communication. `fluent`: near-native, including formal documents. Certificates such as JLPT levels are stated separately and only when the employer asks for one.

eligible_area.description: Where the worker must live or be based, e.g. `JP` for anywhere in Japan.

JobLocation.description: Workplace jurisdiction and coarse area. Never a street address in public payloads.

expected_monthly_hours.description: Typical overtime hours per month, as reported.

excess_paid_separately.description: Whether the submitter states that overtime beyond `hours_per_month` is paid on top.

fixed_overtime.description: 固定残業代 (fixed overtime pay): a set amount of overtime pay included in the base pay figure.

oneOf.description: Only a starting figure was stated (e.g. 「25万円〜」). There is no implied upper bound.

organization_id.description: The employer or agency that submitted the record.

external_reference.description: The feed’s own identifier for the vacancy.

JobRecordSource.description: Where this record came from. livingin.jp lists only direct submissions and feeds it is authorized to use.

pattern.description: `discretionary`: 裁量労働制, hours are not fixed by the employer.

hours_description.description: Working hours and breaks as stated, e.g. "Shifts between 07:00 and 23:00, 8 hours including a 1-hour break".

annual_holidays.description: 年間休日: days off per year, as reported.

time_zone.description: Zone for any clock times in `hours_description`.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page. `null` on the last page.

JobSearchResult.description: Open vacancies only. Coverage is always at least `partial`: livingin.jp lists direct submissions and authorized feeds, not the whole job market, so an empty page does not mean no such jobs exist.

japanese_required_level.description: The `ja` entry’s `required_level`; `unknown` when language expectations are unknown.

JobSummary.description: Card-sized job record. Contains no quality rating or score.

application_deadline.description: Calendar date in Asia/Tokyo. `not_applicable`: open until filled.

JobVacancy.description: Last status reported by the submitter. Read it with `freshness`: a stale `open` vacancy may already be filled. `withdrawn`: the record was explicitly taken down and is no longer active.

Lang.description: Content language. More may be added; clients must tolerate unknown values.

kind.description: `bundle`: a move-out set of individually available items.

published_revision.description: The approved revision being shown. Later edits are not public until approved.

Listing.description: A published listing as the public sees it. Pickup location is deliberately approximate.

pickup_locality_code.description: Municipality code. Must be a marketplace pilot locality.

pickup_area_label.description: Coarse public label, e.g. a station or neighbourhood. Never a street address.

id.description: Omit for a new item; include to keep an existing item.

dimensions.description: `null` when the seller does not know.

ListingPatchInput.description: Fields to replace. `items` replaces the whole item list. Any change creates a new revision that must be submitted again.

seller_verification.description: Screening checks the listing content, not the seller. More values may be added if seller verification is introduced.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page. `null` on the last page.

ListingSearchResult.description: Marketplace runs in pilot localities only; other localities return `coverage.status = unsupported` with no items.

LivingAppliesWhen.description: `only_if`: applies only when the condition is true for the reader. Clients may let readers answer conditions to hide irrelevant items, but an unanswered condition is not false.

code.description: Stable machine-readable key. The same code means the same condition everywhere in a guide or entry, so a reader answers it once.

description.example: Family members live with you in Japan

LivingCondition.description: A stated circumstance that decides whether something applies to a reader. Never inferred from a member’s profile, account or private data.

code.description: `JP`, a prefecture (`JP-13`) or a municipality (`JP-13-113`). Municipality digits follow the JIS X 0402 code without the check digit.

LocalityRef.description: An administrative jurisdiction. Jurisdiction (which rules apply) is distinct from proximity (what is nearby).

LocalizedText.description: Text in the language negotiated with Accept-Language (or the best available), with its translation state.

url.description: Time-limited URL of a processed derivative. Do not persist; re-fetch the resource for a fresh URL.

MediaRef.description: A public, processed image. Quarantined or rejected originals are never exposed through this type.

features.description: Enabled-feature manifest. Clients should hide features that are not `enabled`.

amount.description: Amount in the minor unit of `currency`. JPY has no minor unit, so this is yen.

Money.description: A monetary amount. Never a float. Unknown amounts are expressed with a Knowable wrapper, never as zero.

deposit_months.description: 敷金 in months of rent. `0` is known-none, different from `unknown`.

key_money_months.description: 礼金 in months of rent.

guarantor_company.description: 保証会社 initial fee. `unknown` covers not knowing whether one is required.

fire_insurance.description: 火災保険 premium charged at signing.

other_fees.description: Other fees from the quote, entered by the user. Each is included as given.

MoveInContractTerms.description: Contract terms the user knows. An omitted term is the same as `{ "status": "unknown" }`; `other_fees` defaults to none.

MoveInCostAmount.description: `range` when an input is unknown and the engine applied an assumption. A range is never collapsed into a single figure.

MoveInCostAssumption.description: An explicit assumption the engine made. There are no hidden defaults.

upfront.description: Due at or before signing. Includes refundable amounts.

upfront_refundable_less_deductions.description: The part of `upfront` that is refundable at move-out, less deductions.

MoveInCostEstimate.description: `unsupported`: the rule set does not cover this scenario. It carries no amounts and is never an estimate of zero. Private: never cached publicly or included in profile payloads.

monthly_management_fee.description: 管理費・共益費. Omitted is the same as `unknown`.

locality_code.description: Prefecture or municipality of the property. Decides which regional rules apply.

move_in_date.description: Contract start date (Asia/Tokyo). Used for prorated rent.

MoveInCostEstimateInput.description: User-entered inputs. Not stored, and never added to a profile, analytics or advertising.

MoveInCostExclusion.description: A cost the estimate deliberately does not include.

category.description: `optional`: commonly offered but declinable; never included in `upfront` or `recurring_monthly` totals.

basis.description: `user_input`: computed only from what the user entered. `rule`: from a reviewed rule in `rules`. `assumption`: the user did not know; see `assumption_keys`.

explanation.description: How this amount was computed, contribution by contribution.

assumption_keys.description: Entries in `assumptions` this line depends on.

MoveInCostRange.description: Inclusive range. `min` equals `max` when every contributing amount is exact.

MoveInCostRuleSet.description: Version of the deterministic rule set. The same inputs and version always give the same result. No LLM is involved.

MyGroupMembership.description: The signed-in member’s own membership. A membership is a separate record from the public profile and from event RSVPs.

MyLifeJourney.description: A private journey a task belongs to. More may be added; clients must tolerate unknown values.

waitlist_position.description: Set only when `waitlisted`. 1 is next in line.

offer_expires_at.description: Set only when `offered`. After this the offer passes to the next waitlisted member and this RSVP becomes `cancelled` with `cancelled_by: offer_expired`.

cancelled_by.description: Set only when `cancelled`. `organizer`: the organizer removed the participant.

MyRsvp.description: One of my RSVPs with the occurrence it belongs to. Check `event.status`: an RSVP to a cancelled event keeps its state.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page. `null` on the last page.

MyRsvpPage.description: My RSVPs, ordered by occurrence start, soonest first.

revision.description: Served as the ETag of mutation responses; send it as If-Match to `updateMyTask`.

notes.description: Empty string when there are none.

MyTask.description: A private task. Only ever returned to its owner; contains no public-profile data and never appears in public profiles, search or analytics.

MyTaskDue.description: `date`: a calendar-date deadline, never a midnight timestamp. `datetime`: a specific moment such as an appointment; always user-entered.

anchor_date.description: Date of the rule’s anchor event, e.g. the day you moved in.

MyTaskDueInput.description: `date`/`datetime` are recorded as user-entered. `derive_from_rule` asks the server to apply the task’s rule; only valid when the task’s origin is `rule_derived`.

anchor.description: The event the rule counts from and the date the member gave for it.

MyTaskDueProvenance.description: Who set the due date. `rule_derived`: computed by the server from the rule recorded in the task’s `origin` (which is then always `rule_derived`). Setting an explicit date replaces it with `user_entered`; the origin still records the rule.

guide_title.description: Title when the task was created.

explanation.description: Why the guide suggested this task.

rule_status.description: `rule_changed`: the guide’s rule changed after the task was created. The task and its date are never changed automatically; the member decides whether to recompute.

MyTaskOrigin.description: How the task came to exist.

MyTaskOriginInput.description: `rule_derived`: create from a guide’s `suggest_task` action. The server records the current guide revision and rule version; an unknown suggestion is a validation error.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page. `null` on the last page.

MyTaskPatchInput.description: Fields to replace. Changing `due` to an explicit date makes it user-entered; `derive_from_rule` recomputes from the current rule.

MyTaskStatus.description: `dismissed`: the member decided the task does not apply to them. Not the same as `done`.

verification.description: `verified`: livingin.jp confirmed the organization controls this record. Not an endorsement.

Organization.description: A municipality, agency, nonprofit, business or community group. Accounts act for organizations through role grants; an organization is not an account.

revision.description: Latest revision of the seller’s content. Also served as the ETag.

published_revision.description: Revision currently visible to the public, if any.

has_unsubmitted_changes.description: `true` when `revision` is newer than the revision under review or published. Those edits are not public and need submitting.

OwnerListing.description: The seller’s private view of their listing.

meeting_point.description: Private to the two participants. Never shown publicly or in notification previews.

PickupWindow.description: Calendar dates the seller can hand over items. Exact times are agreed privately in an inquiry.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation safe to show to the requester.

request_id.description: Echoes the X-Request-Id response header. Quote it in support requests.

current_revision.description: Present on `revision_conflict`: the revision the server currently holds.

ProfileSummary.description: Public identity only. Never contains account, contact or private data.

PublicProfile.description: What other people can see about a member. Separate from the private Account.

delay.description: Set when review is delayed, e.g. the screening model is unavailable. Listings never auto-approve on delay.

release.description: Approved listings may wait for the next publication window (up to 30 minutes).

PublicationState.description: Review/publication state of the most recently submitted revision. Separate from item availability. A decision applies only to the revision (and media set) it names.

ReviewState.description: Editorial review state of maintained content or rules.

waitlist_position.description: Set only when `waitlisted`. 1 is next in line.

offer_expires_at.description: Set only when `offered`. After this the offer passes to the next waitlisted member and this RSVP becomes `cancelled` with `cancelled_by: offer_expired`.

cancelled_by.description: Set only when `cancelled`. `organizer`: the organizer removed the participant.

Rsvp.description: A member’s participation record for one occurrence. Private to the member and the event’s organizers; attendee lists are never public. Separate from group membership and attendance.

message_to_organizer.description: Optional note for approval-based events. Visible only to the organizers.

RsvpState.description: `going`: holds a place. `pending_approval`: waiting for the organizer. `waitlisted`: queued for a place. `offered`: a place is held for this member until `offer_expires_at`; RSVP again to accept it. `declined`: the organizer declined the request. `cancelled`: ended (see `cancelled_by`). An event’s own cancellation is shown on the event, not by changing RSVP states.

template_id.description: Stable key of the reviewed guidance template.

text.description: Plain-language guidance from the reviewed template, in the negotiated language.

SafetyExplanation.description: Reviewed, plain-language guidance for a warning product. It supplements the official text and never replaces or contradicts it. It is general preparedness guidance, not personalised instructions, safe routes or shelter status.

freshness.description: `current`: retrieved within the freshness requirement. `stale`: the latest data is older than required and must be shown as possibly out of date, never as reassurance.

retrieved_at.description: When livingin.jp last successfully retrieved and validated the feed for this area (also `source.retrieved_at`).

source.description: The issuer or approved provider the feed comes from.

warnings.description: Warnings in the feed for this area as of `retrieved_at`, including recently cancelled or expired ones. An empty array means "no warnings in effect according to the feed" and is only meaningful when `freshness.state` is `current`. When the feed is stale, an empty array must not be presented as "no warnings".

last_successful_retrieval_at.description: `null` when the feed has never been retrieved successfully for this area.

explanation.description: Safe human-readable explanation. Always states that this does not mean there are no warnings.
Safe human-readable explanation. Always states that this does not mean there are no warnings.

SafetyFeed.description: State of the warning feed for the area. `available`: data exists from `source`, the issuer or an approved provider; check `freshness` — `stale` data must be shown as possibly out of date, never as reassurance. `unavailable`: an upstream or service failure prevents a reliable result; no warnings are listed and this NEVER means there are none. `not_covered`: livingin.jp does not carry warnings for this area (see `coverage`); this also never means there are none.

SafetyFeedUnavailableReason.description: `upstream_outage`: the issuer or provider feed cannot be reached. `upstream_data_rejected`: data was retrieved but failed validation, so it is not shown. `maintenance`: livingin.jp has paused the feed. More values may be added; clients must tolerate unknown values.

SafetyHazard.description: Broad hazard grouping derived from the issuer product, for grouping and icons only. More values may be added; clients must tolerate unknown values.

code.description: Stable key for the issuing authority.

SafetyIssuer.description: The official authority that issued a warning. Its products, wording, tiers and areas are authoritative.

SafetyIssuerArea.description: A warning area exactly as the issuer defines it. Issuer areas do not always match administrative boundaries.

original.description: The issuer’s own wording in its original language (`translation.status = original`). Always present and always authoritative.

localized.description: The official text in the negotiated language. A translation is only ever built from a reviewed translation template for this product (`reviewed_translation`); when none exists the original-language text is returned here unchanged. Official text is never machine translated.

SafetyOfficialText.description: The authoritative meaning of a warning. `original` is the issuer’s own wording and is always present; `localized` is the same text in the negotiated language, from a reviewed translation template or else unchanged. Never machine translated. Explanations supplement this text and never replace it.

official_name.description: The name residents will see on the publisher’s own site, when it is published in Japanese. `null` when the resource’s own name is not Japanese.

authority.description: `official`: published by a government body or the issuer. `editorial`: written and maintained by livingin.jp.

locality.description: The jurisdiction the resource applies to. National resources use `JP`.

languages.description: Languages the resource itself is available in.

last_checked.description: Whether the link and its content were checked recently enough. `stale` means the last check is too old or failed.

SafetyResource.description: A reviewed preparedness or official safety resource. livingin.jp links to it; the publisher remains authoritative for its content.

SafetyResourceKind.description: `hazard_map`: an official hazard map. `evacuation_information`: where the municipality publishes evacuation information (livingin.jp does not report shelter-open status). `official_alert_service`: an official alerting channel residents can subscribe to. `preparedness_guide`: reviewed preparedness guidance. `emergency_contact`: published emergency numbers and contacts. `multilingual_support`: an official or provider multilingual help service.

SafetyResourceLink.description: A short reference to a reviewed safety resource. Fetch the resource for its review and link-check state.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page. `null` on the last page.

SafetyResourceSearchResult.description: Resources whose jurisdiction is the requested locality or one of its parents (national `JP`, the prefecture). This is jurisdiction, not proximity. When local resources for the locality are not maintained, `coverage` says so and national resources are still listed because they apply everywhere.

issuer_areas.description: Areas exactly as the issuer named them. Authoritative.

affected_areas.description: livingin.jp’s reviewed mapping of the issuer areas onto administrative localities. Use `issuer_areas` when the two appear to disagree.

first_issued_at.description: When the issuer first issued this warning (revision 1).

issued_at.description: When the issuer issued the revision shown (`issuer_revision`).

valid_until.description: `null`: the issuer gave no end time; the warning stays in effect until the issuer cancels or replaces it. Never means unknown.

issuer_revision.description: The issuer’s revision number. Only the latest revision is shown; earlier revisions are superseded.

is_test.description: `true` for an issuer test or exercise message. It is not a real warning: clients must label it clearly and never present it as one. The public feed omits test messages except during announced drills.

explanation.description: `null` when no reviewed guidance template exists for this product and language. livingin.jp never generates unreviewed guidance.

source_url.description: The issuer’s own page for this warning, where the authoritative current version can be checked.

SafetyWarning.description: A canonical official warning or advisory as issued, with its issuer, product, tier, areas, times, revision, lifecycle and test flag. The official text is authoritative; the explanation is a reviewed supplement.

SafetyWarningLevel.description: The issuer’s own severity tier (for a Japan-style meteorological issuer: 注意報 advisory, 警報 warning, 特別警報 emergency warning). The issuer’s tier is authoritative: livingin.jp maps its names one-to-one after review and never computes, combines or re-ranks severity. More values may be added for other issuers.

cancelled_at.description: When the issuer cancelled (lifted) the warning.

expired_at.description: The issuer’s stated end of validity, now passed.

SafetyWarningLifecycle.description: `cancelled`: the issuer explicitly lifted the warning. `expired`: its stated validity ended without a further revision. Ended warnings stay in the feed for a limited period so a warning is seen to end rather than silently disappearing.

name.description: The issuer’s product name, e.g. 大雨警報 / おおあめけいほう / heavy rain warning.

csrf_token.description: Send as X-CSRF-Token on unsafe requests authenticated by the session cookie.

published_on.description: Publication or effective date stated by the source, if any.

revision_label.description: The source’s own version label, e.g. a fiscal-year edition.

rights.description: Whether livingin.jp may reuse the content. `link_only`: we cite and link but do not reproduce. Official identity and reuse permission are different questions.

SourceRecord.description: Provenance, rights and review for information livingin.jp maintains or derives.

url.description: Canonical location, when the source is public.

SourceRef.description: Attribution for information derived from a source record.

TranslationState.description: How this text relates to its source language. `stale_translation` means the original changed after this translation was made.

session.name: __Host-livingin_session
session.description: First-party browser session. Unsafe methods also require the X-CSRF-Token header (see CONVENTIONS.md#authentication).

bearer.description: Non-browser clients and the mock server (`Bearer mock:<persona>`).
